llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed brand-narrative registry workflow that reads and updates versioned canon records only with user authorization and host capability checks.

dimensions.detail: Access to narrative event memory, projections, and generated canon/history views is proportionate to maintaining a brand narrative registry.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is a standalone markdown skill with no executable files; it references broader repository runtime and reference files, but says standalone installs must leave bounded proposals when the verified runtime or host capability is unavailable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions require current-revision checks, complete canon proposals, explicit user authorization before writes, validation of claim references, and rejection of stale or partial proposals.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It uses persistent append-only narrative events and generated memory views, but this persistence is disclosed, purpose-aligned, and gated by explicit permission and host capability requirements.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to record and query brand narrative canon, versions, proof pointers, voice, and naming rules; its read/write behavior is directly tied to that registry function.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want a structured, versioned brand narrative canon. Before using write paths, ensure the expected registry runtime and host capability are present, and review proposed canon changes because accepted versions persist in the event stream.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector clean result] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; independent inspection also found no hidden execution, remote payload retrieval, credential handling, or prompt-hijacking behavior.
[A.I.G SARIF no results] expected: The SARIF evidence contained no findings, which matches the inspected artifact: a markdown-only registry workflow with disclosed state reads and controlled writes.
